title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Sequel Finally Confirms Netflix Release Window With First Look Revealed
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is now in the works on returning to Netflix with a brand new sequel series later this year, and has finally revealed when fans will be able to check it out in action with the first full look at its new cast of characters.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Diamond no Ace: Act II Second Season' Second Cour Announced for Fall 2026
content: • The official website of the Diamond no Ace ( Ace of Diamond ) anime series announced the second cour of the Diamond no Ace: Act II Second Season ( Ace of Diamond Act II Season 2 ) anime on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sentimental Graffiti Dating Simulation Game Gets Remake
content: The Weekly Famitsu magazine's live-streamed 40th anniversary event announced on Sunday that production has begun on Entergram's remake of NEC Interchannel 's classic dating simulation game Sentimental Graffiti .
author: ANN

title: King of Prism Anime Gets New Tri-Star Act Film
content: The "King of Prism Super Live Prism☆Tours!" event announced on Sunday that production has begun on King of Prism -Tri-Star Act- , a brand-new film in the King of Prism anime franchise . The story is set during "Prism.3," the competition for trios who perform the franchise 's signature Prism Shows.
author: ANN

title: 5th Girls und Panzer das Finale Film's Trailer Previews Story
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks posted the first full trailer, first key visual, and story for the fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer das Finale film series on Sunday. title: Live-Action Strange: Junji Ito's Tales for Sleepless Nights Series Rearranges Episode Order
content: The staff had planned to air and stream the "Lovesickness" (Part 1)" episode as the second episode of the overall series, but it will premiere as the first episode now. The staff has not specified when the previously planned first episode, "The Mansion of Phantom Pain," will air and stream later.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Reveals Female Main Cast Member Taliya Yang, Fall 2026 Release Date
content: Studio TRIGGER has introduced its first CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 female main cast member, Taliya Yang, as the fourth character ahead of the anime’s Fall 2026 release. title: Though I am an Inept Villainess Anime's New Subtitled Video Unveils Rokudenashi's Ending Song
content: The staff for the television anime of Satsuki Nakamura 's Though I Am an Inept Villainess ( Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga - Sūgū Chōso Torikae Den ) light novel series started streaming a pre-broadcast promotional video on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. Season 2 Streams 2nd Promo Video
content: The official website of Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. , the television anime based on Sekka Iwata and Yū Aoki 's Magilumiere Co. Ltd. ( Kabushikigaisha Magilumiere ) manga, started streaming the second promotional video for the second season on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Anime Gets 3rd Season
content: The official website for the second television anime season based on Fujino Ōmori and Toshi Aoi 's Wistoria: Wand and Sword ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) manga announced in an teaser on Sunday that production on a third season has been green-lit.
author: ANN
